name_en: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) - pension for unorganised workers
benefit: A pension of at least Rs 3,000 a month after you turn 60. You pay a small amount each month (Rs 55 to Rs 200, based on your age when you join), and the Central Government adds the same amount. If you die while getting the pension, your husband or wife gets half of it.

other: Monthly income must be Rs 15,000 or less.
Age when you join must be 18 to 40.
You need a savings bank account or Jan Dhan account with IFSC.
Not for people working in the organised sector.
Not for members of EPFO, NPS or ESIC.

documents: Savings bank or Jan Dhan account passbook
how_to_apply: Go to your nearest Common Services Centre (CSC). The worker there checks your Aadhaar, enters your bank, mobile and nominee details, and tells you the monthly amount. Pay the first amount in cash and sign the auto-debit form. You get a Shram Yogi card. After that, the money is taken from your bank account every month, so keep enough money in it.

evidence.quote: A minimum assured pension of ₹3,000/- per month is provided to the subscriber after attaining the age of 60 years.

A matching contribution is provided by the Central Government on a 50:50 basis, where an equal amount to the subscriber's age-specific contribution (ranging from ₹55/- to ₹200/-) is credited to the pension account.
The spouse of the beneficiary shall be entitled to receive a family pension equal to 50% of the pension received by the beneficiary.
The applicant must have an entry age between 18 and 40 years.
